items.raw_excerpt: Despite Sunday's loss against the Roosters, Newcastle Knights fans remain proud of the team's effort.
items.summary_en: Newcastle Knights lost to the Roosters on Sunday in the grand final. Even so, local fans say they are proud of the team's effort. Many plan to keep supporting the club.

items.title_en: Knights fans stay proud after grand final loss
items.title_ko: 결승에서 진 날에도 뉴캐슬 나이츠 팬들은 자랑스러워

items.raw_excerpt: Breitling and Aston Martin Aramco Formula One bring high-performance motorsport and Swiss watchmaking together at a race-inspired pop-up in Singapore.
items.summary_en: Breitling and Aston Martin Aramco Formula One opened a race-themed pop-up store in Singapore. It mixes fast motorsport style with Swiss watchmaking at Raffles City. Visitors can enjoy F1 thrills in the heart of the city.

items.raw_excerpt: Rediscovering hope: Parambikulam’s Wildlife Week spotlights the rediscovered Haplothismia exannulata with a photos exhibit highlighting small forest wonders.
items.summary_en: A plant once thought extinct is featured at Parambikulam Wildlife Week in Kerala. Photos on display highlight the small wonders of the forest.

items.title_ko: 한때 멸종된 것으로 여겨졌던 식물이 야생동물 주간의 주인공이 되다
items.title_original: Once thought extinct, a plant becomes star of Wildlife Week at Keralam’s Parambikulam

items.raw_excerpt: The 53-year-old actor, who has mostly played supporting and cameo roles in local television dramas, made his feature-film leading debut as a hawker in Anthony Chen's latest film.
items.summary_en: Andi Lim is a 53-year-old actor from Singapore. For many years he played small supporting and cameo roles in local TV dramas. Now he has his first lead film role, and it earned him a Golden Horse nomination.
items.summary_ko: 앤디 림은 싱가포르의 53세 배우입니다. 오랫동안 현지 드라마에서 조연과 단역을 맡았습니다. 이제 그는 영화에서 처음으로 주연을 맡았고, 골든호스 후보에 올랐습니다.
items.title_en: Singapore actor Andi Lim earns first Golden Horse nomination after 30 years
items.title_ko: 싱가포르 배우 앤디 림, 30년 만에 첫 골든호스 후보에 올라

items.raw_excerpt: In this remote corner of central Australia, the Santa Teresa/Ltyentye Apurte horse races are a dusty affair with the best in cowboy fashion.
items.summary_en: People in a remote part of central Australia gather for the Santa Teresa/Ltyentye Apurte horse races. Racers and fans wear their best cowboy fashion in the dusty outback. It is a small local event full of community spirit.

items.title_ko: 호주 중부 사막마을에서 열린 카우보이 경마 대회

items.raw_excerpt: More than 125 years after a kiwi-feather cloak was given away, it's finally being returned by a British museum to the iwi that made it.
items.summary_en: A British museum is giving back a kiwi-feather cloak to the iwi that made it. The cloak was given away more than 125 years ago. It is now coming home to the Marlborough iwi.
items.summary_ko: 영국 박물관이 키위 깃털로 만든 망토를 그것을 만든 마오리 부족에게 돌려주고 있다. 이 망토는 125년도 더 전에 다른 곳으로 넘어갔었다. 이제 말버러 지역 부족의 품으로 돌아온다.
items.title_en: British museum returns a 126-year-old feather cloak to a New Zealand tribe
items.title_ko: 영국 박물관, 126년 된 키위 깃털 망토를 뉴질랜드 부족에 돌려준다
items.title_original: British musuem returns 126-year-old kahu kiwi to Marlborough iwi

items.summary_en: The first leg of the Copa Chile quarterfinal between Antofagasta and Universidad de Chile will be played at the Estadio Regional Calvo y Bascuñán. Fans are asking where and when they can watch the match.

items.title_original: ¿Cuándo y dónde ver la ida entre Antofagasta y la U por cuartos de la Copa Chile?

items.raw_excerpt: Para o recolhimento, os moradores devem colocar os entulhos para fora do imóvel na data da passagem dos caminhões
items.summary_en: The city of Curitiba is running a cleanup campaign against mosquitoes in October. It will visit the CIC, Portao, Santa Felicidade, and Matriz districts. Residents must put old junk and debris outside their homes on the day the trucks pass.
items.summary_ko: 쿠리치바시가 10월에 모기 퇴치를 위한 대청소 캠페인을 진행한다. CIC, 포르탕, 산타 펠리시다드, 마트리스 네 지역을 차례로 찾는다. 주민들은 청소 차량이 지나는 날 집 밖에 쓰레기와 폐기물을 내놓아야 한다.
items.title_en: Curitiba No-Mosquito Campaign Visits Four Districts in October
items.title_ko: 쿠리치바 모기 퇴치 캠페인, 10월에 네 개 지역 방문
items.title_original: Mutirão Curitiba sem Mosquito estará nas regionais CIC, Portão, Santa Felicidade e Matriz em outubro - Prefeitura de Curitiba

items.raw_excerpt: El cuadro albo goleó a Deportes Iquique y el conjunto cruzado dejó en el camino a Unión Española.
items.summary_en: Colo Colo beat Deportes Iquique in the Chilean Women's League. Universidad Catolica knocked out Union Espanola. The semifinal lineup is now complete.

items.summary_en: Coquimbo Unido will host Cobreloa in the second leg of their Copa Chile tie. The match will be played at Francisco Sánchez Rumoroso Stadium in Coquimbo. Fans can check the time and place to watch the game.

items.raw_excerpt: Una asociación pide cambiar la ley que regula los depósitos arqueológicos
items.summary_en: Local museums in Córdoba want to change the law that controls archaeological deposits. They say the current rules make it hard to keep and show local finds. The museums are asking officials to update the rules.
items.summary_ko: 스페인 코르도바의 지역 박물관들이 고고학 유물 보관을 정하는 법을 바꾸자고 나섰다. 지금 규정으로는 지역에서 나온 유물을 보관하고 전시하기 어렵다고 말한다. 박물관들은 당국에 규정을 새로 정비해 달라고 요청하고 있다.
items.title_en: Local museums in Córdoba push to change rules on archaeological deposits
items.title_ko: 코르도바 지역 박물관들, 고고학 유물 보관 규정 바꾸자고 주장
items.title_original: Los museos locales de Córdoba insisten en modificar la normativa - Diario Córdoba

items.raw_excerpt: Alongside five mates, Hayden Sumner has completed a cross-country relay from Perth to Sydney in honour of his late mother, who spent years in abusive relationships.
items.summary_en: Hayden Sumner ran across Australia with five friends. They went from Perth to Sydney in a relay. The run raises awareness of domestic violence and honours his mother.
items.summary_ko: 헤이든 섬너는 다섯 친구와 함께 호주를 가로질러 달렸다. 퍼스에서 시드니까지 이어달리기를 완주했다. 이 달리기는 가정폭력에 대한 경각심을 높이고 어머니를 기리기 위한 것이다.
items.title_en: Runner crosses Australia from Perth to Sydney for his late mother
items.title_ko: 러너, 세상을 떠난 어머니 위해 퍼스에서 시드니까지 달려
items.title_original: Runner honours mother in epic Perth to Sydney relay for DV awareness

items.raw_excerpt: Athletes from Karnataka returned with a creditable haul of four gold medals, three silvers and two bronzes from the 2026 Asian Games, which concluded in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, on Sunday.
items.summary_en: Athletes from Karnataka won four gold, three silver and two bronze medals at the 2026 Asian Games. The games ended in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, on Sunday.

items.raw_excerpt: It’s a day for wagging tails, happy faces and a special annual blessing at a church in the Philippine capital.
items.summary_en: Priests in the Philippine capital blessed dogs, cats, and even a snail. It was a special yearly event for St. Francis, the patron saint of animals. People brought their pets for a happy day of wagging tails and smiling faces.
items.summary_ko: 필리핀 수도에서 사제들이 개와 고양이, 심지어 달팽이까지 축복했다. 동물의 수호성인인 성 프란치스코를 기리는 매년 열리는 특별한 행사다. 사람들은 반려동물과 함께 나와 꼬리를 흔들고 웃는 즐거운 하루를 보냈다.
items.title_en: Philippine priests bless dogs, cats and a snail for St. Francis feast

items.raw_excerpt: Tombado pela Prefeitura do Recife, baobá do Fundão, na Zona Norte da capital, faz parte da história e da identidade do bairro
items.summary_en: A large baobab tree in the Fundão neighborhood of Recife was planted by enslaved people long ago. The city has now listed the tree as protected heritage. It stands as a living reminder of the area's history and identity.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 헤시피 북부 푼당 동네에 있는 커다란 바오밥 나무는 오래전 노예로 끌려온 이들이 심은 것이다. 시 당국은 이 나무를 보호 문화재로 지정했다. 이 나무는 동네의 역사와 정체성을 그대로 간직한 살아 있는 증거로 남아 있다.
items.title_en: A baobab tree planted by enslaved people tells the story of a Recife neighborhood

items.title_original: Plantado por pessoas escravizadas, Baobá revela raízes do bairro do Fundão, no Recife - Diario de Pernambuco

items.raw_excerpt: Quer viver um dia de ferroviário?
items.summary_en: A local railway museum in Pinhal Novo opens its doors for visitors. People can spend a day learning about trains and railway history. It is a small, friendly outing for families and train fans.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 핀할 노부의 작은 철도 박물관이 방문객에게 문을 연다. 기차와 철도 역사를 하루 동안 배울 수 있다. 가족과 기차 팬에게 어울리는 소소한 나들이다.

items.raw_excerpt: The CTBC Brothers clinched the Chinese Professional Baseball League's (CPBL) second-half title Sunday with a 12-1 victory over the TSG Hawks, securing a playoff berth after finishing last in the first half.
items.summary_en: The CTBC Brothers beat the TSG Hawks 12-1 on Sunday. The win gave them the second-half title in Taiwan's pro baseball league. They now have a spot in the playoffs.
items.summary_ko: 중신 브라더스가 일요일 TSG 호크스를 12대 1로 꺾었다. 이 승리로 대만 프로야구리그 후반기 우승을 차지했다. 이제 포스트시즌에 나갈 자리를 얻었다.

items.title_original: Brothers clinch second-half title, secure CPBL playoff berth

items.raw_excerpt: Pubs have been at the heart of village life for centuries, but as drinking habits changed some have closed and others have had to adapt and expand to stay relevant.
items.summary_en: A village pub in Yorkshire is trying new things to stay open. The Black Lion now runs allotments, a cafe, clubs, a shop and a caravan site. The pub changed as local drinking habits changed over the years.
items.summary_ko: 요크셔의 한 마을 펍이 문을 닫지 않으려고 새로운 시도를 시작했다. 블랙 라이언은 이제 텃밭과 카페, 동아리, 상점, 캐러밴 사이트를 함께 운영한다. 마을 사람들의 술 마시는 습관이 변하면서 펍도 달라졌다.
items.title_en: Yorkshire village pub adds allotments, cafe, shop and caravan site
items.title_ko: 요크셔 마을 펍, 텃밭과 카페, 상점, 캐러밴 사이트까지 문을 열다
items.title_original: Yorkshire village pub The Black Lion branches out with allotments, cafe, clubs, shop and caravan site - Yorkshire Post

items.raw_excerpt: Tasmanian business get creative to tackle surcharge ban.
items.summary_en: A cafe owner in a small Tasmanian town is asking customers to pay with cash. A new rule stops shops from adding card fees, so the owner must pay them from the shop pocket. The owner says the shop cannot take the extra cost anymore.
items.summary_ko: 태즈메이니아의 작은 마을 카페 주인이 고객에게 현금 결제를 요청했다. 새 규정 때문에 카드 수수료를 손님에게 부과할 수 없게 되어 주인이 비용을 떠안아야 한다. 주인은 추가 비용을 더는 감당할 수 없다고 말했다.
items.title_en: A small town cafe owner in Tasmania asks customers to pay cash
items.title_ko: 작은 마을 카페 주인, 고객에게 현금 결제 요청
items.title_original: 'Can't wear it anymore': Small town cafe owner asking customers to pay cash - The Examiner
